<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ProductDevelopment" name="Product Idea and Prototype Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_ProductDevelopment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RD" name="R&D team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ResearchFeasibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Process starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IdentifyIdea" name="Identify product idea or improvement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResearchFeasibility" name="Conduct initial research and feasibility studies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftConcepts" name="Draft design concepts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectDesign" name="Select promising design"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildPrototype" name="Build prototype using available materials and resources"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestPrototype" name="Test prototype functionality, safety, and market potential"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectFeedback" name="Collect testing feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Refinement" name="Is refinement needed?" default="Flow_NoRefinement"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefinePrototype" name="Refine prototype"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Outcome" name="Decide prototype outcome"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Approved" name="Approved for further development"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Discarded" name="Discarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_IdentifyIdea"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyIdea" targetRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ResearchFeasibility" targetRef="Task_DraftConcepts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_DraftConcepts" targetRef="Task_SelectDesign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SelectDesign" targetRef="Task_BuildPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_BuildPrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_TestPrototype" targetRef="Task_CollectFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_CollectFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_Refinement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinementNeeded" name="Refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Refinement" targetRef="Task_RefinePrototype">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refinement is needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRefinement" name="No refinement needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Refinement" targetRef="Gateway_Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefinedToTesting" sourceRef="Task_RefinePrototype" targetRef="Task_TestPrototype"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">approved for further development</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discarded" name="Discarded" sourceRef="Gateway_Outcome" targetRef="EndEvent_Discarded">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">discarded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
